mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate increases the cost of capital for equities, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and consumer price inflation (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 320.5) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that increases real interest rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * CPIAUCSL change) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1400) signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong manufacturing sector (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures that signal strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.1%), increased real interest rates reduce risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.1%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
